_about: Rules content set aside by the party rework (Oct 2026): kept for reference and possible reuse on other cards, not used in the game. Working engine code for all of it is in git at the commit below.

oldHeroes.name: Warchief Grukka Ironjaw
oldHeroes.triggerText: When a Capital card enters play, draw two resources.
oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: your hero gets +1 to all stats for each Orc companion you control.

oldHeroes.name: Thorgar Twice-Buried
oldHeroes.triggerText: When an Undead card enters play, draw a resource.
oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: while an opponent controls a Dwarf companion, it gets -1 to all stats.

oldHeroes.name: Aelthir Moonveil
oldHeroes.triggerText: When a Guile challenge is faced, draw a resource.
oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: when a Elf card enters play under your control, draw a resource.

oldHeroes.name: Lord Vaelis Nightbloom
oldHeroes.triggerText: When a hero falls, draw 3 resources.
oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: while an opponent controls a Elf companion, it gets -1 to all stats.

oldHeroes.name: Pip Wanderfoot
oldHeroes.triggerText: When a location is replaced by an ability, draw a resource.
oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: your hero gets +1 to all stats for each Halfellow companion you control.

oldHeroes.name: Kazra Emberdeep
oldHeroes.triggerText: When an Ironbound card enters play, draw a resource.
oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: when a Dwarf card enters play under your control, draw a resource.

oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: your hero gets +1 to all stats for each Elf companion you control.

oldHeroes.name: Mayor Hobby Trickgrin

oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: while an opponent controls a Halfellow companion, it gets -1 to all stats.

oldHeroes.kinText: Kin: when a Human card enters play under your control, draw a resource.

setAsideCards.name: Mags Tolliver, Market Trader
setAsideCards.quote: “I've haggled with dwarves, love. A lich is nothing.”
setAsideCards.abilityText: At the end of bidding, you may double your hero's stats. At the end of the encounter this card is discarded.

setAsideCards.name: Hobart Thimblewick, Moot Surgeon
setAsideCards.abilityText: During bidding, you may force another player to use their hero's guile stat in place of another stat.
setAsideCards.revision: Was Sir Hugo Pellam (Human); now a Halfellow.

setAsideCards.name: Caelan the Exile
setAsideCards.abilityText: During bidding, you may force another player to use their hero's mental stat in place of another stat.

setAsideCards.name: Sir Osric Vane, Marshal of the Old Guard
setAsideCards.quote: “I have seen five Midsummer Fairs end in a brawl. This is merely the sixth.”
setAsideCards.abilityText: Your hero contributes their guile stat in place of another stat when it is higher.
setAsideCards.revision: Now also gains +1 when the swap is used (was a below-average card).

setAsideCards.name: Rosalind Marchwell, Marchguard Clerk
setAsideCards.abilityText: Your hero contributes their mental stat in place of another stat when it is higher.
setAsideCards.revision: Was Posy Marchbank (Halfellow); now a Human.

setAsideCards.name: Brisa Blastcap, Bombardier
setAsideCards.abilityText: During bidding, you may force another player to use their hero's physical stat in place of another stat.

setAsideCards.name: Grumma Ladlejaw, Camp Cook
setAsideCards.quote: “Nobody marches on an empty belly. Not even the Warchief.”
setAsideCards.abilityText: During bidding on your turn, you may force another player to use their hero's physical stat in place of another stat.
setAsideCards.revision: Was Clemence Fairbrook (Human); now an Orc.

1002.name: Thorgar Twice-Buried
1002.was: Once per game, at the end of bidding, if this hero would fall, it doesn't. Instead, you draw 3 resources.

1003.name: Aelthir Moonveil
1003.was: Before bidding on any turn, choose a companion of an opponent. That companion does not contribute any stats this turn.

1007.name: Ysolde of the Wellspring
1007.was: You may have a maximum of three companions instead of two.

1009.name: Lord-Paladin Aldric Ashcroft
1009.was: During bidding, you may disable one ability of another player's heroes or companions. Once per turn, you may counter an ability of another player's heroes or companions as it is used.

1010.name: High Thane Brunna Stonefast
1010.was: Ignore any opponent's ability that would force a hero or companion under your control to contribute a different stat, stop one of your companions contributing stats, or make one of your resource cards count as a negative.

1015.name: Loremaster Oskar Grimgate
1015.was: Before bidding, once per turn, choose an opponent. If that opponent uses an ability against your hero or companions, you may draw a resource.

2023.name: Dagny Coldhearth, the Grudge-Bearer
2023.was: At the end of bidding, you win the current encounter and automatically take the location. However, you must discard all resources and your hero falls. You may use this ability only once per game.

3020.name: The Wardens' Hall
3020.was: All players immediately draw a resource card for every Warden they have in play (heroes count).

5006.name: The Hall of Rest
5006.was: If your hero would fall after this card is played, you may choose your next hero from the hero stack instead of drawing one.

5031.name: The Amulet of Aesia
5031.was: If your hero would fall the round this card was played, it doesn't; instead, draw a resource card for every other player.

5076.name: The Book of Grudges
5076.was: When this card is revealed or played face up, if you lose the current encounter (your hero falls), the winner has -3 during the next encounter. It has +1 if your hero is Oskar.
